---

## Executive Summary

Resistance Labs is an independent software studio building commercial tools for knowledge workers, researchers, graduate scholars, and self-directed learners. Our flagship product is **ATLAS Workspace**, an intelligent spatial personal knowledge environment designed to connect reading, active recall, spatial cards, and 3D maps into a living body of knowledge stored locally on user disk.

---

## Flagship Product: ATLAS Workspace

- Category: Personal Knowledge System (PKS) & Spatial Research Workspace
- Status: Production Release v0.0.50
- Desktop Builds: Windows (.exe), macOS Apple Silicon & Intel (.dmg), Linux (.AppImage, .deb)
- Live Portal: https://resistancelabs.tech/
- Documentation: https://resistancelabs.tech/docs.html
- Community Marketplace: https://resistancelabs.tech/marketplace.html

### Pricing & Monetization Model
- **Core Edition ($0 / Included)**: Complete offline desktop sovereignty, unlimited local SQLite/Markdown notes, 3D spatial knowledge graph, native PDF/EPUB reader, freehand visual canvas, and Spaced Repetition (SRS) flashcard engine.
- **ATLAS Pro ($12 / month)**: Production AI features powered by Claude models (multi-document semantic synthesis across dense literature corpuses, interactive video lectures and real-time comprehension quizzes from YouTube transcripts, automated active-recall flashcard authoring from reading highlights, interactive Socratic card chat and practice exam generation, and encrypted end-to-end cloud sync).

---

## Technical & AI Architecture

1. **Multi-Document Literature Synthesis (Claude 3.5 Sonnet)**:
   In ATLAS Workspace, high-capacity contextual reasoning parses full-length books (EPUBs) and complex research monographs (PDFs) to build conceptual connections across personal research archives and extract key insights.

2. **Active Recall & Exam Authoring (Claude Models)**:
   Structured JSON tool calling transforms reading notes and video transcripts into rigorous spaced-repetition card decks and interactive practice examinations with immediate retention feedback.

3. **Prompt Caching & Low-Latency Retrieval**:
   Applies prompt cache breakpoints across static user document corpuses to enable low-latency interactive querying across large libraries without repetitive token processing overhead.

4. **Data Sovereignty & Local-First Persistence**:
   Primary user data resides on local disk in SQLite and open Markdown formats. Cloud resources scale predictably with active Pro subscriptions.
